notes: Source facts live in this registry. Application code must load metadata from here rather than hard-coding publisher URLs.
Inactive sources are documented so officers can see why an indicator is UNAVAILABLE.

sources.source_name: Population Projections for India and States, 2011-2036
sources.publisher: National Commission on Population, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.dataset_version: July 2020 report; TABLE-21 as on 1 March
sources.license_note: Official Government of India statistical publication. Used here as a transcribed public table snapshot.
sources.transformation_notes: Published figures are thousands of persons. Snapshot stores persons = thousands × 1000. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana 2011 values are reconstituted successor-state populations, not undivided Census 2011 Andhra Pradesh.
limitations: State level only. Not constituency, district, block, or locality.
2011–2036 projection series; not a live census enumeration.
Nearest published year may be used only with an explicit documented gap.

sources.publisher: SARVSAKSHI controlled test fixture (not a government schedule of rates)
sources.license_note: TEST/SYNTHETIC fixture. Not an official SoR and not for REAL mode.
sources.transformation_notes: None. Rates are labelled test values.
limitations: Not an official CPWD, AP PWD, or MoSPI schedule of rates.
REAL mode must not consume this fixture.
Unit rates cannot be compared to a total allocation without a compatible quantity.

sources.publisher: Central Public Works Department, Government of India
sources.license_note: Official CPWD publication. No verified machine-readable public bulk extract was available for this prototype.
sources.transformation_notes: Not integrated. PDF schedules were not transcribed into invented unit rates.
limitations: Official SoR is typically published as PDF, not a public bulk API.
No credentialed or structured extract is configured.
Cannot be used as project expenditure.

sources.source_name: Andhra Pradesh PWD Schedule of Rates
sources.publisher: Public Works Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
sources.license_note: State public-works publication. No verified public machine-readable extract was bundled.
sources.transformation_notes: Not integrated. No unofficial scraped rates were substituted.
limitations: No legally attributable structured SoR snapshot was available for bundling.
Cannot be inferred from MPLADS allocation amounts.

sources.publisher: Open Government Data Platform India / National Informatics Centre
sources.license_note: Government open data. API access typically requires a registered API key.
sources.transformation_notes: Not called unless SARVSAKSHI_DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY is configured.
limitations: Requires configuration. Absence of a key is reported as SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_REQUIRES_CONFIGURATION.
No API key is stored in source code.

sources.publisher: International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.license_note: Official survey publication. State factsheets are PDFs.
sources.transformation_notes: Not integrated. Percentages were not transcribed from PDFs without a verified machine-readable extract.
limitations: No verified structured NFHS-5 amenity table was bundled.
State household percentages are not project-specific infrastructure evidence.

sources.source_name: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract (district)
sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
sources.transformation_notes: Not integrated. The current MPLADS extract has no reliable district identifier, and district values are not fabricated from IDA or constituency text.
limitations: Project records in the cleaned extract do not contain a verified district field.
Constituency is not treated as equal to district.
IDA name is not used as a district code.
